Your AI agent needs a browser. It shouldn't need your window.

S3 Browser 2.4 connects Claude Code and Codex on your Mac. They work in background tabs with a space's sign-ins, and the window you're using stays yours.

Before an agent runs page code on a site, S3 asks you once for that site.

Private tabs leave no trace, and agents can't see your private windows.

Free for Apple silicon Macs, macOS 15.4 or later.

linkedin:
Most browsers were built for one person at a keyboard. Ours was built for you and your AI agents.

S3 Browser 2.4 connects Claude Code and Codex during setup, using the command-line tools already on your Mac and your own account. Setup shows where to install a missing tool or which Terminal command signs you in; when it's ready, one button connects it.

From there an agent can work in any space's sign-ins, or in private tabs that leave no trace, without touching the window you're working in.

You stay in charge:
· Agents ask once per site before running page code
· Private windows keep no history and agents can't see them
· Reading a site's storage needs your approval, every time

Free for Macs with Apple silicon (macOS 15.4 or later).
https://s3dat.com/products/s3-browser
